newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank/SILF Sept purchasing index rises to 55.3.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank/SILF Sept purchasing index rises to 55.3.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Swedbank and logistics institute SILF said on Tuesday that their purchasing managers' index for September had increased to 55.3 from 54.3 in August and 48.4 in July.

"The improvement in the September index is a further indication that the economy has bottomed out. If this positive trend is confirmed next month then we can be even more certain that this is the case," Swedbank/SILF said in a statement.
The index is a composite of factors such as order intake, production, delivery times, purchased stocks and prices of components and raw materials.

"Both production and order intake rose noticeably in September. In addition to the strong development of export order intake, it is encouraging to see that the domestic market also contributed to the upturn in the index," the statement said.
